## 2. Primary Offer: Fixed-Fee Cloud & AI Cost Governance Diagnostic

- **Service Scope Page:** https://aicloudstrategist.com/services/
- **Pricing Page:** https://aicloudstrategist.com/pricing/
- **Sample Deliverable Structure (Synthetic Method Sample):** https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/sample-diagnostic-deliverable/
- **Who It Is For:** Founders, CTOs, CFOs, VPs of Engineering, FinOps leads, and platform owners at mid-market and scale-up companies facing unexplained AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, or GPU/LLM spend or an upcoming production AI release decision.
- **What It Delivers:**
  1. Reconciles cloud, Kubernetes, GPU, and model/token spend to specific workloads, products, and accountable engineering/product owners.
  2. Separates genuine demand growth from idle waste, unallocated shared-platform overhead, and unit-cost drift.
  3. Prioritizes an evidence-backed 30-day action plan distinguishing safe immediate waste cuts from architectural or commitment changes that require reliability validation.
- **Commercial Model & Turnaround:**
  - **Step 1 — Free Fit Review:** Free 30-minute suitability and scoping review (no billing exports or credentials required upfront).
  - **Step 2 — Fixed-Fee Diagnostic:** Typical single-estate fixed fee **USD 2,500–3,000** (India **INR 1,00,000–1,50,000**); Production AI Readiness Diagnostic from **INR 1,50,000 / USD 1,800**. Turnaround ~2–3 weeks after agreed evidence intake.
  - **Founding-Customer Offer:** 40% discount for the first three consenting customers in exchange for written permission to publish anonymized/approved outcomes.
  - **Why Fixed Fee (No Savings-Share):** Never charges contingent percentage-of-savings fees that incentivize risky rightsizing or multi-year lock-in commitments.

## 4. Strict Evidence & Safety Boundaries (Must Not Invent)

- **No Guaranteed Savings or Fixed ROI Claims:** AICloudStrategist never promises a predetermined percentage reduction before inspecting actual workload evidence.
- **No Production Changes Executed During Diagnostic:** The diagnostic is an independent, read-only/evidence-based advisory engagement; engineering teams retain full deployment control.
- **Not a Statutory Financial Audit or Security Certification.**
- **Zero Sensitive Data in Public Forms:** Public enquiry and fit-review forms never collect cloud credentials, raw billing exports, or personal/regulated customer records; confidential evidence moves only through an agreed channel after mutual NDA signature.
